% Pattern: declaration/class. A class defines \newtheoremrm, a \newtheorem
% with an upright body, and a paper macro calls it. Seen in the gold pilot
% (set X).
% want remark-1 remark 1
% want eg-1 example 1
\documentclass{catjournal}
\makeatletter
\def\defthm#1#2#3{\newtheoremrm{#1}{#2}}
\makeatother
\defthm{eg}{Example}{Examples}
\begin{document}
\begin{remark} Every finite space is compact. \end{remark}
\begin{eg} The unit interval is compact. \end{eg}
\end{document}
